title: India AI Impact Summit 2026 (16-20 Feb, New Delhi)
summary: Theme: People, Planet, Progress; PM unveiled **MANAV Vision** (Moral, Accountable, National sovereignty, Accessible, Valid).

items: Theme: People, Planet, Progress; PM unveiled **MANAV Vision** (Moral, Accountable, National sovereignty, Accessible, Valid).
**New Delhi Declaration on AI Impact** — endorsed by **89 countries** (Bangladesh = 89th signatory).
India joined **'Pax Silica'** (US-led critical-minerals/AI coalition); compute scaling beyond 38,000 GPUs with +20,000 more.
India's Global Innovation Index rank improved **81 → 38**; next summit (2027): Geneva, Switzerland.

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → 🔥 HIGH — MANAV acronym, 89 signatories, GPU numbers, 2027 host city.
